tools.name: start_pie_session
tools.description: Launch a Play-In-Editor (PIE) session to test gameplay. Requires Full Access security mode. After starting, use read_message_log to check for runtime errors, simulate_input to interact, and stop_pie_session to end. CRITICAL: You MUST call stop_pie_session before attempting to modify Blueprints, recompile C++, or change level layouts. Modifying assets while the game is running will cause errors.

start_mode.description: Where to start the player (default: default_player_start)

tools.name: simulate_input
tools.description: Inject keyboard or gamepad input during an active PIE session. Use to test movement, abilities, and interactions. Common keys: W/A/S/D for movement, SpaceBar for jump, LeftShift for sprint, E for interact.

action_type.description: 'press' = tap (down+up in one frame), 'down' = hold, 'up' = release (default: press)

duration.description: Duration to hold the key in seconds (0-10). Note: for sustained input, use 'down' then 'up' in separate calls.

tools.name: stop_pie_session
tools.description: Stop the current Play-In-Editor session. After stopping, use read_message_log to review any runtime errors that occurred during play.

tools.name: extract_ui_state
tools.description: Extract the hierarchy and properties of active Slate and UMG widgets in the editor viewport during PIE.

widget_class_filter.description: Optional class name filter, e.g. UUserWidget, SButton

tools.name: trigger_ui_element
tools.description: Trigger an interaction (e.g. click, hover) on a Slate or UMG widget identified by its path or label.

widget_name.description: Label or path of the widget to trigger.

tools.name: query_world_state
tools.description: Query the state and positions of all active actors in the PIE world.

tools.name: invoke_pie_widget_delegate
tools.description: Directly broadcast a script delegate (e.g. OnClicked) on a UUserWidget or child widget instance during a Play-In-Editor (PIE) session.

widget_class_or_name.description: Class or instance name of target UUserWidget (e.g. 'W_MainMenu_C', 'W_MainMenu')

widget_property_name.description: Child widget property name or target widget property (e.g. 'PvPButton', 'StartButton')

delegate_name.description: Multicast delegate property name to broadcast (default: 'OnClicked')

tools.name: get_active_runtime_widgets
tools.description: Query all active runtime UUserWidget instances during a Play-In-Editor (PIE) session with visibility, parent hierarchy, and child counts.

include_hidden.description: Whether to include collapsed or hidden widgets (default: true)

tools.name: execute_console_command
tools.description: Run an Unreal Engine console command targeting the active PIE world context (e.g. 'slomo 0.1', 'stat fps', 'FlushPersistentDebugLines').

command.description: Console command string to execute (e.g. 'slomo 0.1', 'stat unit').

world_context_index.description: Optional PIE world context index for multiplayer PIE (default: 0).

tools.name: call_pie_actor_function
tools.description: Invoke a UFUNCTION by name on an actor in the active PIE world (e.g. triggering debug functions or gameplay events).

actor_name.description: Name or path of the actor in the PIE world.

function_name.description: Name of the UFUNCTION to invoke on the actor.
